facts.fact: The National Assembly adopted Law n°045-2009/AN on 10 November 2009 regulating electronic services and transactions (electronic signatures, electronic formalities, e-commerce contracts, trust service providers), and it was promulgated by Decree n°2009-824/PRES on 4 December 2009; the document gives no repeal.
facts.system: Loi n°045-2009/AN portant réglementation des services et des transactions électroniques
